title: CPR
text: Start compressions at once if there is no normal breathing: heel of the hand on the centre of the chest, 100 to 120 per minute, 5 to 6 cm deep, full recoil between pushes.
Give 30 compressions then 2 rescue breaths; keep going with minimal pauses.
Attach the AED as soon as it arrives, follow its voice prompts, and clear the person before any shock.
Do not stop except to swap rescuers, follow the AED, or on signs of life. Hand over to the crew medical officer.
